You're right, I apologize for the outdated assumption. If production and staging have separate configurations after the cluster migration, then `FEATURE_EXPORT` wouldn't automatically be in production just because it's in staging.

You'll need to check the production environment configuration directly to see if the variable is actually set there. Since they're no longer sharing a template, it's quite possible the flag was added to staging but never made it to the production config—which would explain why the feature isn't working in production even though it works locally and in staging.
